Rachel Lim Jia-Yi

My Higher Level Physics Internal Assessment was stalled until the Eduvanta faculty guided my laser interferometry experiment. They taught me how to write like an academic researcher rather than a student completing a worksheet. That single transformation lifted my confidence across all three Higher Level subjects."

REV008St. Joseph’s Institution

Kimberly Ng Xin-Hui

Attained AL1 in PSLE Mathematics and secured Direct School Admission (DSA) to Raffles Girls’ School.

"My daughter loved science but would freeze when faced with 5-mark non-routine math heuristics on PSLE papers. Eduvanta’s diagnostic clinic pinpointed her exact cognitive block: trying to jump into arithmetic before visualizing the invariant state. The faculty taught her systematic bar model transcendence. By the mid-year prelims, she was completing Paper 2 with 20 minutes to review."

Destination: Awarded Public Service Commission (PSC) Overseas Merit Scholarship
REV014Raffles Girls’ School

Hannah Yeo Jing-Ting

Attained 90/90 Rank Points in GCE A-Levels and awarded PSC Overseas Merit Scholarship to Oxford.

"In Junior College, many students study 14 hours a day without understanding the marker’s rubric. Eduvanta’s General Paper and Economics seminars felt like university tutorials at Oxford. We analyzed real-world Singapore central bank policies and global technological shifts. My essays evolved from regurgitated paragraphs into cohesive, dialectical treatises. I entered the A-Level examination hall knowing exactly how to command the highest mark band."

Destination: University of Oxford (Philosophy, Politics & Economics - PPE)
REV020Methodist Girls’ School

Clarissa Tan Xue-Er
